description:
Move one of the reader's magnets, what draws their own edition: a `target` and a step (away, low, normal,
high) saves at once. For a subject no target names, a `draft` of their own words: without `preview` it answers
what the draft would give a day, the pieces it finds, and a `confirm` digest; with preview=<confirm> it saves.
Their own words are the cause. The same move again changes nothing.

cause.description: The reader's own words, kept verbatim as the cause.

anyOf.description: A definition of a reader's own words, one saved version of it (docs/field/own-words.md).

anchors.description: Codes, countries and entities, each with its use.

items.description: A code, a country or an entity the definition leans on, and how.

key.description: country:XX (ISO 3166-1), medtop:NNNNNNNN (an IPTC Media Topic code in the tree) or wd:Qnnn (a Wikidata item), normalised as a magnet's target is.

release.description: A Media Topic code's IPTC release; null on a country or an entity.

use.description: An entity selects or excludes; a code or a country gates or excludes, never selects (0.00 to 0.02 precision as selectors).

author.description: Who wrote this version: the reader, an assistant in conversation, or the owner.

breadth.description: narrow (about it) by default; broad adds adjacent pieces.

counter.description: Up to 8 pieces the reader does not want, the same shape.

items.description: A piece the definition should find (an example) or should not (a counter-example).

item.description: The piece's item id. Not checked against the pool, which prunes.

title.description: The piece's title as stored, so the definition outlives it.

why.description: Why it is in or out, in a few words ("water", "a strike").

examples.description: 3 to 8 pieces the reader wants, with their titles stored.

items.description: A piece the definition should find (an example) or should not (a counter-example).

item.description: The piece's item id. Not checked against the pool, which prunes.

title.description: The piece's title as stored, so the definition outlives it.

why.description: Why it is in or out, in a few words ("water", "a strike").

interest.description: One sentence of what the definition is about: what any future model reads, and a magnet's label.

names.description: The names it goes by, per ISO 639-1 language: model-free recall. A name matches whole words, case aside, in a piece's title or teaser, whatever the piece's language; a space or hyphen in it matches a space, a hyphen or nothing, and `*` any letters (a truncation).

said.description: The reader's words, verbatim; Profile reads them back to that reader.

preview.description: The `confirm` digest a draft's preview answered, to save that very draft.

target.description: What to move: world, country:XX (ISO 3166-1), medtop:NNNNNNNN (an IPTC Media Topic), wd:Qnnn (a Wikidata item), word:<a few words> for a subject no code names, or def:<n> for a saved definition.

name: save_interest
title: Save an interest
